name: Iceberg
look: A photo of an iceberg in calm ocean water, split at the waterline. Above, a small white peak sits under a blue sky with wispy clouds. Below the surface, a far larger glowing blue mass of ice reaches down into the dark blue depths.
use: Contrasts the small part everyone sees with the huge hidden part underneath. The tip gets the surface-level or well-known thing and the underwater bulk gets the obscure, deeper or hidden stuff, sometimes as layered tiers of ever more niche lore.
slots: the small visible part, on the white tip above the water
the huge hidden part, on the underwater ice (often several items going deeper)
examples: The one song everyone knows by the band
47 albums, three side projects and a polka phase
describe: iceberg with a small top above water and a huge part below
giant chunk of ice hidden under the ocean surface
ice mountain peak sticking out of the sea
underwater view of a big blue iceberg
chart that goes deeper into obscure stuff below the water
